scripts.run-mockup: npm run build-mockup && npm run serve
scripts.deploy-mockup: npm run build-mockup && cd .. && npm run build && npm run deploy-project
scripts.mock2: npm run build-css && npm run build-mock && npx tailwindcss --config ./tailwind.config.js -o ./themes/lexjet/lexjet-theme.css --watch
scripts.switch-site: if [ -z "$npm_config_site" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run switch-site --site=SITE_NAME --branch=BRANCH_NAME"; exit 1; fi && if [ -z "$npm_config_branch" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run switch-site --site=SITE_NAME --branch=BRANCH_NAME"; exit 1; fi && cd .. && git checkout $npm_config_branch && cd mockup && node set-site.js $npm_config_site
scripts.which-site: cd .. && echo "Git branch: $(git branch --show-current)" && cd mockup && echo "Site config: $(cat .site-config 2>/dev/null || echo 'No site configured')"
